schema_version.description: Schema version for this JSON file format. Integer only.

starting_debt.description: Starting debt in in-game dollars. Whole-number currency amount.

weekly_debt_interest.description: Weekly debt interest rate as a decimal fraction, not a percentage. Example: 0.10 means 10% per week.

catch_vig.description: Collector catch vig as a decimal fraction, not a percentage. Example: 0.30 means 30%.

bookmaker_overround.description: Bookmaker overround as a multiplier, not a percentage. Example: 1.10 means a 110% book.

league_avg_goals.description: League average expected goals PER TEAM per match (Poisson lambda baseline), as a positive decimal. Example: 1.35 per team implies roughly 2.7 total goals per match.

home_advantage.description: Home-team goal advantage in expected-goals units, not a percentage.

validation_targets.description: Validation targets for future simulation checks. Rates remain decimal fractions, not percentages.

blind_roi.description: Expected blind betting return on investment as a decimal fraction. Example: -0.08 means -8%.

informed_win_rate_min.description: Lower bound for informed betting win rate as a decimal fraction. Example: 0.55 means 55%.

informed_win_rate_max.description: Upper bound for informed betting win rate as a decimal fraction. Example: 0.60 means 60%.
